server.definition: A Mattermost server connection configured in the desktop app; each server appears in the server list and opens in its own view.

tab.definition: A tab inside the app window showing a view of a server; users can open, close, and switch tabs.

view.definition: An open server page inside the app; the number of simultaneously open views is limited.

main window.definition: The app's primary window containing the server tabs, as opposed to popout windows.

popout window.definition: A separate window split off from the main window to show a tab or view on its own.

system tray.definition: The OS status area (Windows/Linux) where the app can show its icon and keep running when closed.

notification area.definition: The area of the OS taskbar where the tray icon is displayed; used in Windows settings wording.

minimize to tray.definition: To hide the app window into the system tray instead of closing it.

Dock.definition: The macOS application bar where the app icon can bounce and show a badge; use the platform's localized macOS term.

taskbar.definition: The Windows bar with running apps, where the app icon can flash and show a badge; use the platform's localized Windows term.

badge.definition: The small counter or dot on the app icon indicating unread messages or mentions.

bounce.definition: The macOS Dock icon animation used to draw attention when a notification arrives.

flash.definition: Making the Windows taskbar icon blink when a new message is received.

start app on login.definition: Setting that launches the desktop app automatically when the user signs in to the OS.

check for updates.definition: To query for a newer desktop app version; can run automatically or on demand.

downloads.definition: The app's list of downloaded files and app updates, opened from the downloads dropdown.

developer tools.definition: Chromium debugging tools that can be opened for the app wrapper, a server view, or the Calls widget.

spell checker.definition: The built-in spelling check for typed text, with selectable languages and an optional custom dictionary URL.

certificate.definition: A TLS or client certificate the app validates or presents when connecting to a server.

authentication secret.definition: A shared secret an administrator provides so the app can pass server pre-authentication.

hardware acceleration.definition: Setting that uses the GPU for rendering; can be disabled to work around graphics issues.

dark mode.definition: The dark UI theme of the app window, toggleable from the View menu.

title bar.definition: The bar at the top of the window; the app can use the OS-native title bar or its own.

zoom.definition: Changing the display scale of the app content (Zoom In, Zoom Out, Actual Size).

full screen.definition: Window mode where the app fills the entire screen, toggleable from the View menu.

clear data.definition: To delete locally cached app data, either for one server or for the whole app.

logging level.definition: The verbosity setting for the app's diagnostic logs (error, info, debug, etc.).
